definitions.explanation: Something incorrect or wrong, a deviation from what is accurate.

examples.japanese: {誤|あやま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{誤|あやま}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{直|なお}してください→直す：00869_naosu⟧。
{誤|あやま}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}な→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦ことだ→こと：01164_koto⟧。
⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{誤|あやま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ないか→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認：00158_kakunin⟧。
examples.english: I checked if there were any errors in the documents.

examples.japanese: ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{誤|あやま}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{繰|く}り{返|かえ}さないように→繰り返す：02051_kurikaesu⟧、⟦{原因|げんいん}→原因：01400_genin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しっかり→しっかり：01272_shikkari⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: To avoid repeating the same mistake, I thoroughly investigated the cause.

notes:
{誤|あやま}り is the noun form of the verb ⟦{誤|あやま}る→誤る：27433_ayamaru⟧ (to err). It refers to errors, mistakes, or inaccuracies, with a slightly formal tone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {誤|あやま}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧: there is an error
- {誤|あやま}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{犯|おか}す→犯す：10059_okasu⟧: to commit an error
- {誤|あやま}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{認|みと}める→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧: to admit a mistake
- {誤|あやま}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{正|ただ}す→正す：10132_tadasu⟧: to correct an error
- {誤|あやま}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{気|き}づく→気付く：01933_kizuku⟧: to notice a mistake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{間違|まちが}い→間違い：03733_machigai⟧: mistake (general, everyday — most common)
- {誤|あやま}り: error (slightly formal, often written/official contexts)
- ⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧: mistake (loanword, casual — common in workplaces)
- ⟦{過|あやま}ち→過ち：14376_ayamachi⟧: mistake, fault (literary/moral connotation)

Do not confuse with ⟦{謝|あやま}り→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧ (apology), from the verb ⟦{謝|あやま}る→謝る：01177_ayamaru⟧ (to apologize) — different kanji, same reading.
